composition_subtypes.role: Groups nodes by shared bits to construct graph, detect triangles
BFS to find shortest cycle through neighbor pairs

payload.core_composition_summary: Bit manipulation groups nodes by shared bits to build graph and early exit if triangle exists; then BFS over each node's neighbor pairs finds shortest cycle.
payload.rationale: Bit ops group nodes by shared bits, build graph, early exit if triangle. Then BFS from each node's neighbor pairs exhaustively finds shortest cycle.
